summary.text: Mighty Pelagon whom Nestor arrayed beside Alastor, Chromius, lord Haemon, and Bias shepherd of the host when Poseidon roused the Achaeans — no homonym in the atlas.

story.text: Agamemnon found Nestor drawing up his comrades around mighty Pelagon and Alastor and Chromius and lord Haemon and Bias — charioteers first with horses and cars, then footmen to be a bulwark of battle.
